description: This file defines an immutable Java class `DefaultThrottlingConfig` which implements the `ThrottlingConfig` interface. It encapsulates configuration parameters `interval` (a Duration) and `limit` (an integer) for throttling purposes, constructed from a configuration source. It provides getter methods, equality, hash code, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultThrottlingConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of `ThrottlingConfig` providing access to throttling interval and limit, constructed from external configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance from a Typesafe `Config` object.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the throttling limit as an integer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on `interval` and `limit`.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on `interval` and `limit`.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration.
